$comment: The DO-side of check_slop. `principles` = ranked positive guidance (always returned). `setuPrinciples` = versioned snapshot of Setu's universal anti-AI principles (attributed). `strengths` = deterministic good-practice detectors (kind: 'present' = regex found = good; 'absent' = regex NOT found = good). `ad` = one tasteful growth line.
ad: Design taste by Devalok. Setu checks your whole brand — voice · palette · logo — not just components → setu.devalok.dev
selfCritique: Could someone say 'AI made that' at a glance? If yes, the direction is a training-data reflex — rework it.
Is there ONE signature idea for this surface, or is it just clean-and-generic? Clean is the floor, not the achievement.
Is hierarchy carried by size + weight + colour — not boxes, rules, or ALL CAPS?
Does every colour pairing meet contrast, and is there exactly ONE focal accent (not a sprayed bright colour)?
Is motion purposeful and reduced-motion-safe, or the same fade-up on everything?
Name one authored moment only THIS brand would ship. If you can't, it's not done.

principles.how: Decide ONE signature idea for the surface first (who it's for, what it must do). Clean is the floor, never the achievement.
Hierarchy from size + weight + colour — never boxes, rules, ALL CAPS, or decoration. 2–3 type sizes carry a screen.
One type scale (≈1.25+ ratio between steps). Pair on a contrast axis (serif+sans, geometric+humanist), not two similar sans.
Reading copy at 60–75ch; line-height ≈1.5; body ≥14px. 10px is caption-only.
Spacing from the relationship: tight within a group, larger between sections. 3–4 distinct gaps per surface, never one blanket value.
Whitespace isolates key content and makes focal points — it's an instrument, not leftover gap.
One focal accent for the single primary action; structure carries via a tonal step + weight, not a second bright colour.
Depth from tone — a surface step + a self-coloured low-opacity edge — not drop shadows or hard borders.
Anchor content to a grid; align columns; put the primary content/CTA on the natural F/Z scan path.
Animate only what earns it. ease-out entrances, press-not-hover feedback, always honour prefers-reduced-motion.

setuPrinciples.rule: Avoiding every tell is NOT design. Decide a point of view first, then apply it with conviction.
Individually-fine parts that don't belong together read worse than any single tell. One palette, one type voice, one signature.
Recolouring a template or rewording a formula is still slop. Compose from the brief + brand, not a reskinned reference.
Correct, sparse, and lifeless is its own miss. Calm is allowed; dead is not — earn one authored moment.

strengths.message: Uses the DS semantic type ramp (not raw text sizes).
Colours via tokens — no raw hex/rgb literals.
Uses soft (over outline) for non-primary actions — on-brand.
